source.body:
## Status on 20 October 2026

The protected production release [39373511823](https://github.com/SlopDotCash/slopdotcash/actions/runs/39373511823) published main `2ec7d6128d98d89cf517117230e000853c24e56a`. Its immutable site is https://713cdc41.eliza-computer.pages.dev/.

This list separates merged code from live acceptance. An open item is not complete merely because its code is merged.

## Mainnet and money

- [ ] #898 Base mainnet factory. The owner must select the registrar and identity authority, then sign the deployment.
- [ ] #899 Robinhood Chain factory. The fee wallet is recorded in #940. Testnet qualification and the owner-signed deployment remain.
- [ ] #900 Ethereum factory. The fee wallet is recorded in #940. Sepolia qualification and the owner-signed deployment remain.
- [ ] #901 Solana mainnet upgrade. A human must sign the upgrade and authority change. The deployed bytes must match the reviewed build.
- [ ] #902 Four-network acceptance. The runner is merged. Funded test accounts, testnet deployments and reconciled transactions remain. PR #947 merged the Ethereum payout registration correction after exact-head local verification, browser evidence and all hosted checks passed.
- [ ] #903 Independent contract audit and counsel review. Internal automated review does not meet this requirement.
- [ ] #904 Mainnet payouts. The service code is merged. Managed attester setup, network configuration, audit acceptance and authorized payments remain. #959 merged the exact-signature reconciliation repair for a finalized binding whose response is lost; this is source and test evidence, not a mainnet payment.
- [ ] #905 Fee conversion. The source is merged and signing remains off. Custody, routes, target assets and controlled acceptance remain.
- [x] #907 Withdrawal fee decision. The owner chose the same 2% fee as payouts; #934 and #936 record the change.

## Operations

- [ ] #906 Admin email. The protected production workflow has deployed `slop-notify`. #942 merged the missing Pages binding into development at a273cb10. Actual application delivery to the authorized inboxes still needs proof.
- [ ] #908 Project listing. Project maintainers must submit applications. Admins must verify authority, terms, funding and security before activation.
- [x] #832 Scheduled workflow branch. The repository default branch is now `main`. Integration pull requests still target `development`.
- [ ] #640 Human review and physical-device acceptance. Preserve the named review and policy decisions in that issue.
- [ ] #797 Review recovery. #917 restored accepted awards. The disputed review credit still requires a maintainer decision; automation must not assign it.

## MVP implementation and acceptance

- [ ] #909 Community security vetting. The result-ingestion and gating code is merged. Production currently returns `vetting_unavailable`. Review found missing executable pipeline components, not only missing configuration. PR #951 merged isolated artifact quarantine. PR #956 merged immutable repository acquisition and signed queue/template acquisition after all hosted checks passed; duplicate #952 is superseded. Draft #953 adds independent provider transports and still needs real provider evidence. PR #958 merged a bounded hardware VM component with an actual harmless guest boot, shutdown, timeout and image-refusal evidence. PR #963 merged content-bound harmless guest execution and syscall evidence after all hosted checks passed. Arbitrary project execution, required interception and complete collectors remain open. Real clean/incomplete/malicious service acceptance remains. PR #948 merged signed malicious-result bans; #950 merged affected-recipient notices with full local verification, uploaded browser evidence and all hosted checks passed. #959 merged the independently reproduced Solana lost-response reconciliation correction after real validator and hosted checks passed. Draft #955 adds evidence reconciliation and publication. #957 merged acquired, artifact and VM evidence assembly at `d47f0fcd` after full local verification, 40 registry browser checks, the actual connected component workflow and all hosted checks passed. It preserves incomplete status. #964 merged a bounded kernel artifact-denial fixture at `bb314d59` after final local, real VM and hosted checks passed. It proves materialized-file denial after collector death and refuses failed policy loading; arbitrary interpreter/JIT/memory interception remains missing. #966 merged the connected signed-source, analyzer, guest and assembly workflow at `2459cd15`, with full verification, 40 browser checks and all hosted checks passed. #967 merged controlled offline dependency acquisition at `248ed394` after 32 real network workflows, full verification, 40 browser checks and all hosted checks passed. Failed downloads retain bounded private evidence and lineage; this does not provide runtime proxy coverage. #968 merged separate private R2 evidence storage, reasoned operator inspection and evidence-backed continuing clearance at `9fef5e3c` after full verification, 44 real browser workflows, uploaded before/after video and all hosted checks passed. Storage policy and production activation remain unset. #970 merged connected dependency evidence assembly at `b5cbdeae` after full verification, 40 browser checks, 13 independent refusal cases and all hosted checks passed. The assembly remains incomplete and made no model call or publication. #972 merged bounded large-artifact retention and native operator downloads at `c7bcdb40` after full verification, 49 real browser workflows, final-head videos and all hosted checks passed. All five saved browser files matched the actual 23,592,960-byte VM overlay. #974 merged canonical captured-evidence closure at `42c62a7d` after full verification, 49 browser workflows, actual retained-byte workflows, final-head videos and all hosted checks passed. Captured references are retained, but the assembly remains incomplete and clean claims are refused. External runtime inputs and physical retention controls remain separate. These components do not enable arbitrary repositories or establish full service acceptance.
- [ ] #910 Private security bounties. Case handling is merged. PR #945 merged restricted verified-recipient delivery, bounded retry, evidence-bound reconciliation and explicit acknowledgment. Local verification, four browser widths and all hosted checks passed. PR #954 merged protected deployment wiring with separate staging opt-in, private-routing checks and verified bindings/schedules. All final-head local and hosted checks passed. Live qualification remains. The private settlement adapter and its recovery workflows are not implemented: the approved plan requires a human-selected payment rail and confidentiality terms first. Review also found that disclosure decisions need to bind exact approved redacted evidence and embargo changes; PR #961 merged this source correction at `0b561e61` after full verification, real browser before/after evidence and all hosted checks passed. The isolated staging acceptance matrix remains.
- [ ] #911 Quarantine, bans and reinstatement. Enforcement is merged. PR #943 merged the repair that requires a fresh scan before reinstatement. PR #948 merged system-issued malicious bans, finding-bound independent reinstatement and a stale admin-panel repair after all hosted checks passed. Maintainer-selected moderator IDs and a real staging ban/reinstatement check remain.
- [ ] #912 Notification inbox. The inbox is merged. Baseline walkthrough evidence is uploaded. PR #949 merged connected verified-email preferences and delivery at e95d0023 after exact-head full verification, eight browser workflows, uploaded video evidence and all hosted checks passed. Live mail acceptance remains.

## Close-out

- [ ] #913 Completion record. Record exact source, test, deployment and live acceptance evidence after the gates above pass. Maintainers must approve the record.

The repository owner requested completion of this tracker with sub-agents. Source repair and checks are in progress. No project, payment, security program or future phase is activated by this tracker.

---
Maintainer operational task. The repository owner asked for this issue on 19 October 2026.
